verdict.rationale: The evidence never addresses data region or residency directly. Dagster can be self-hosted (the OSS Docker deployment runs the webserver, daemon and code locations in your own containers), and a Dagster+ agent runs code-server tasks in the user's own AWS Cloud Map setup. Both suggest the user controls where data and compute live, but only by implication. Missing for 10: explicit Dagster+ region selection, documented data-residency guarantees, documentation of which metadata stays in Dagster's cloud versus in the user's infrastructure, and independent corroboration.
